result.summary: Review of target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930) over scope: Git URL/branch/author/command shell boundaries, escaping, credential handling, path injection. Verdict FINDINGS (3). HIGH: push verification trusts the worker-writable ${workspace}/.swarmforge/git-base for the merge-base ancestor and reported base_commit (src/providers/freestyle.ts:140,255), so a worker can fabricate the persisted handoff base; reproduced with a real local bare remote (push+ls-remote exited 0 with base_commit==commit). MEDIUM: safety.ts:14 tests the raw SWARMFORGE_GIT_TREE for a leading slash, so the documented none:/abs path form is never scanned and destroy can delete a VM holding unpersisted external-tree work; reproduced by running the generated script. LOW: the App installation token and SSH private key are in no redaction set, so the artifact credential guard passes them through (readArtifact returned both in probes); Redactor's URL regex also misses ssh:// userinfo. quote(), branchFor(), '--'-guarded push/clone, config pinning, artifact path validation and the release workflow's quoted tag use were all checked and found adequate. Targeted tests: 67 pass, 0 fail.
result.details:
Scope read: src/git-handoff.ts, src/providers/freestyle.ts (every vm.exec command string, quote, credential staging), src/safety.ts, src/files.ts, src/security.ts, src/serve-command.ts, src/config.ts, src/coordinator.ts (handoff/destroy), src/settings/*, src/runtime.ts, src/cli/*, scripts/build.ts, scripts/package.ts, scripts/smoke.ts, .github/workflows/release.yml.

F1 HIGH src/providers/freestyle.ts:255 (written at :140): pushBranch reads the base commit back from ${SWARMFORGE_WORKSPACE}/.swarmforge/git-base, a file inside the workspace the worker owns; guest exec runs as root (lines 116/143) and the unit at :173 sets no User=. The worker writes that path between checkout and push, so merge-base --is-ancestor is trivially satisfiable and base_commit / the GitHub compare review_url become worker-chosen. The clean-tree guard only covers the repository and the persistence scan excludes .swarmforge (safety.ts:38). Reproduced locally with the exact line-255 command string against a real local bare remote: exit 0, base_commit == commit. Recommendation: keep the base in control-plane state and pass it as a literal; fail closed on mismatch.

F2 MEDIUM src/safety.ts:14: roots includes the external tree only when the raw SWARMFORGE_GIT_TREE starts with '/', but gitTree() (config.ts:165-169) accepts the documented none:/abs/path form (docs/ENVIRONMENT.md:15) and workerEnvironment (config.ts:178) gives the worker the stripped path. Running the generated script with a clean workspace plus dirty external tree: absolute form -> safe:false 'files outside a Git repository'; none: form -> safe:true 'no obvious unpersisted work'. fail() (:786-802) and destroy (:940-958) then take the failed/destroy path instead of recovery_required. Recommendation: use gitTree(...).target and add a none:/abs test.

F3 LOW src/security.ts:43: redactorFor knows only Freestyle token, model key, MCP bearer token and worker passwords; commandRedactor adds SWARMFORGE_GIT_PUSH_URL. Neither knows the per-push App installation token (git-handoff.ts:74) or the SSH key read at freestyle.ts:210-218, yet files.ts:70 and :103 gate on redactorFor. Probe: readArtifact returned a fake OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY artifact (58 bytes) and a ghs_ token artifact (33 bytes), neither blocked; Redactor leaves ssh://user:pass@ intact. Recommendation: add both credentials to the redaction context for the push window and extend the URL regex beyond https?.

Adequate after review: quote() is a correct POSIX single-quote escaper (probed with quotes, $(), backticks, newline, tab, backslash); branchFor maps all non-[A-Za-z0-9_-] to '-' and strips edge dashes so no branch can carry a metacharacter or leading '-'; push/ls-remote/clone use '--' plus quoting so a hostile push URL cannot become a Git option or second refspec; the start command is operator config and worker values go through export k=quote(v); App-mode config pins the tree to the exact GitHub HTTPS URL; credentials never appear on a command line (GIT_ASKPASS / GIT_SSH_COMMAND, 0600, removal failure raised) and the key is absent from all commands per tests; artifact paths reject absolute/backslash/NUL/dot segments with a per-prefix symlink stat; the safety script double-JSON-encodes roots (a hostile root stayed data); scripts use Bun.spawn arrays, the archive allowlist is checked before extraction, and release.yml passes the tag only via env + quoting.

Limitations: no full suite (other reviewers); no cloud/provider calls; F1 reproduced at shell-command level rather than against a live provider; F3 confirmed only at the redaction layer; Bun 1.4.2 under /tmp/bun142, lockfile untouched. Note (not filed): pushBranch does not quiesce the guest service first (complete() at coordinator.ts:692), leaving a short root-readable credential window; judged consistent with the existing guest-trust assumption.

tests.summary: 67 pass, 0 fail, 442 expect() calls, exit 0 (git-handoff+safety alone: 11 pass, 0 fail). Disposable /tmp probes: quote() escaping table; gitTree vs safety-roots divergence; real-git push + ls-remote verification with worker-forged git-base (exit 0, base_commit==commit); readArtifact guard with SSH key and App token (both returned); Redactor ssh:// handling. /tmp/rv32 clean; /workspace/repo untouched at 5672ead.

warnings: F1 (HIGH): the durable handoff base is read from a worker-writable file, so persisted=true and the compare review_url are not actually verified.
F2 (MEDIUM): documented none:/abs tree form escapes the persistence scan, risking VM deletion with unpersisted work.
F3 (LOW): App installation token and SSH private key are in no redaction set; the artifact guard therefore does not block them.
Target reviewed in a disposable detached clone at /tmp/rv32 (Bun 1.4.2 at /tmp/bun142); no source changes, commits, pushes, merges or tags; no credential values in any output.
result.followup_reason: Actionable findings: (1) HIGH - move the handoff base commit out of the worker-writable ${workspace}/.swarmforge/git-base into control-plane state and fail closed on mismatch (src/providers/freestyle.ts:140,255); (2) MEDIUM - derive the persistence scan root from gitTree(SWARMFORGE_GIT_TREE).target so none:/abs paths are scanned, with a test (src/safety.ts:14); (3) LOW - include the GitHub App installation token and SSH private key in the redaction context used by files.ts/coordinator.ts/runtime.ts and extend the URL regex past https? (src/security.ts:43, src/serve-command.ts:45).
